Say hello to EverShelf! 🍲 

A self-hosted, MIT-licensed smart pantry manager to stop food waste (140+ ⭐ on GitHub).

✨ Features:
• Barcode scanning & quick stocktake
• AI expiry tracking & zero-waste recipes (Gemini, Llama)
• Home Assistant & Calendar (ICS) sync
• Android Kiosk mode for kitchen tablets

🔗 Live Demo: https://evershelf.site/demo/?lang=en
💻 GitHub: https://github.com/dadaloop82/EverShelf

🏆 Contest running: https://github.com/dadaloop82/EverShelf/discussions/299
